newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX products pare losses.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX products pare losses.

text.p: Brent crude futures were steady on Tuesday and did not trade in a shortened session on SIMEX.
February Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $23.20/$23.30 per barrel at the 1600 hours (0800 GMT) close, around the London settlement price of $23.19.
Brokers said Brent held steady in the absence of a strong move by NYMEX crude on after-hours ACCESS system.
NYMEX February crude was last traded at $24.85, down just six cents from the New York session overnight.
But heating oil, which has led the futures complex this week, extended its slide on ACCESS.

January heating oil fell 1.89 cent to 71.08 cents per gallon in New York overnight and as far as 70.55 on ACCESS. But, by late afternoon in Asia the contract had strengthened to 70.85 cents, down 0.23 from New York.
Brokers said lower-than-normal temperatures were expected for Wednesday to Friday in the U.S. northeast which probably prompted some short covering.
SIMEX Brent is closed until Friday when it will trade a normal session 0925-1758 hours (0125-0958 GMT).
